items.translation: and while the prison's education room was showing a movie, they secretly climbed into the ceiling,

items.text_zh: 几个月以来，我一直没有想到好的办法，最终把目光瞄向了油带下方的托架。

items.text_zh: 虽然托架高度有限，藏不住东西，但却是一个很好的承重装置。
items.draft: Although the support frame was limited in height and couldn't hide anything, it was a good load-bearing device.
items.translation: Although the support frame was limited in height and couldn't hide anything, it was a good load-bearing device.

items.text_zh: 巧的是我从车间领班那里偷听到了一个消息说，

items.translation: Coincidentally, I overheard a piece of news from the workshop foreman,

items.text_zh: 那些破旧的未分类的友邦会在接下来一周运到监狱外的中转仓存储。
items.draft: that those old, uncategorized packages would be shipped to the transfer warehouse outside the prison next week.
items.translation: that those old, uncategorized packages would be shipped to the transfer warehouse outside the prison next week.

items.text_zh: 我知道机会来了，于是开始建造我的逃生舱。
items.draft: I knew the opportunity had come, so I started building my escape pod.
items.translation: I knew the opportunity had come, so I started building my escape pod.

items.text_zh: 基于任劳任怨的老好人风格，
items.draft: Based on my style of being a hardworking nice guy,
items.translation: Based on my style of being a hardworking nice guy,

items.text_zh: 我的工位被安排在工厂隐藏的小角落里，整天和发霉的破油带打交道，
items.draft: my workstation was arranged in a hidden corner of the factory, dealing all day with moldy old oil bags,
items.translation: my workstation was arranged in a hidden corner of the factory, dealing all day with moldy old oil bags,

items.text_zh: 而这恰好给了我更大的操作空间。
items.draft: which just happened to give me more operational space.
items.translation: which just happened to give me more operational space.

items.text_zh: 我运气不错，当时别的狱友都被调走，干奖金更高的分拣工作，只留我一个人在这里收尾。
items.draft: I was lucky; at that time, other inmates were reassigned to sorting jobs with higher bonuses, leaving me alone to finish up here.
items.translation: I was lucky; at that time, other inmates were reassigned to sorting jobs with higher bonuses, leaving me alone to finish up here.

items.text_zh: 我将大量废弃的邮包用胶布打包成捆掏空中心。
items.draft: I bundled a large number of discarded mail packages with tape, hollowing out the center.
items.translation: I bundled a large number of discarded mail packages with tape, hollowing out the center.

items.text_zh: 用塑料板、废弃金属等一些有支撑性的东西撑起了一个小空间，
items.draft: I used plastic boards, discarded metal, and other supportive materials to create a small space,
items.translation: I used plastic boards, discarded metal, and other supportive materials to create a small space,

items.text_zh: 并用拉链绑好，固定到托架上。最后在底部开了一个小的入口，可以从中钻进去。
items.draft: and secured it with a zipper to the support frame. Finally, I made a small entrance at the bottom to crawl in.
items.translation: and secured it with a zipper to the support frame. Finally, I made a small entrance at the bottom to crawl in.

items.text_zh: 虽然这个计划很冒险，很可能会被狱警发现。

items.translation: Although this plan was risky and could easily be discovered by the guards,

items.text_zh: 我还可能会窒息其中，但我的人生信条是要不自由，要不死。
items.draft: I might even suffocate inside, but my life motto is to either be free or die.
items.translation: I might even suffocate inside, but my life motto is to either be free or die.

items.text_zh: 可第一个逃生舱，其内部空间太小，根本就钻不进去。于是我又制作了头身舱，二号

items.draft: The space is still small, but it can't be expanded further, or the target will be too obvious.
items.translation: The space is still cramped, but it can't be expanded further, or the target will be too obvious.

items.text_zh: 造好逃生舱，我开始准备逃生，要准备的各种物品，

items.translation: After building the escape pod, I began preparing for the escape, gathering various items,

items.translation: such as a breathing tube, food, water, a small knife, and more.

items.text_zh: 这一些还只是我越狱第一阶段所需，
items.draft: These are just what I need for the first phase of my escape,
items.translation: These are just what I need for the first phase of my escape,

items.text_zh: 一旦逃离监狱，狱方肯定要展开大规模搜捕，
items.draft: Once I escape from prison, the authorities will definitely launch a massive manhunt,
items.translation: Once I escape from prison, the authorities will definitely launch a massive manhunt,

items.text_zh: 想要逃出包围圈，还需要准备更多东西。
items.draft: and I need to prepare more items to break out of the encirclement.
items.translation: and I need to prepare more items to break out of the encirclement.

items.text_zh: 一身普通的运动服，一件背心，一双阿迪的运动鞋以及一张地图，
items.draft: A regular tracksuit, a tank top, a pair of Adidas sneakers, and a map,
items.translation: A regular tracksuit, a tank top, a pair of Adidas sneakers, and a map,

items.text_zh: 这些是我逃亡第二阶段，必要的装备。
items.draft: these are the necessary gear for the second phase of my escape.
items.translation: these are the necessary gear for the second phase of my escape.

items.text_zh: 我原计划是在四月一日行动，
items.draft: I originally planned to act on April 1st,
items.translation: I originally planned to act on April 1st,

items.text_zh: 因为那天是愚人节。
items.draft: because that day is April Fool's Day.
items.translation: because that day is April Fool's Day.

items.text_zh: 我心想，也许警方在初期接到报警时会误以为是恶作剧，
items.draft: I thought maybe the police would mistakenly think it was a prank when they received the initial report,
items.translation: I thought maybe the police would mistakenly think it was a prank when they received the initial report,

items.text_zh: 所以说这种可能性微乎其微，但哪怕增加万分之一的胜算，我也要考虑进去。
items.draft: so the likelihood of that happening is very low, but even if it increases my odds by one in ten thousand, I have to consider it.
items.translation: so the likelihood of that happening is very low, but even if it increases my odds by one in ten thousand, I have to consider it.

items.text_zh: 然而，计划赶不上变化，那天是周六，厂区没有安排工作计划，只能延迟。

items.translation: However, plans can't keep up with changes; that day was Saturday, and there was no work schedule at the factory, so I had to delay.

items.text_zh: 四月五日早上六点，我兴奋的起床吃过早饭，于七点二十分准时抵达我的工作区。
items.draft: On April 5th at six in the morning, I excitedly got up, had breakfast, and arrived at my work area at seven twenty.
items.translation: On April 5th at six in the morning, I excitedly got up, had breakfast, and arrived at my work area at seven twenty.

items.text_zh: 偷偷藏好食物和那身逃跑用的运动服。

items.text_zh: 虽然被值班经理发现了，但关键时刻老好人的形象发挥了作用。他没有深究。

items.translation: Although the duty manager found out, my good-natured image played a role at a critical moment. He didn't investigate further.

items.translation: At seven fifty, I used a cart to bring the rack to my workstation,

items.draft: and this scene became part of the surveillance footage, capturing my last moments.
items.translation: and this scene became part of the surveillance footage, capturing my last moments.

items.draft: To ensure someone could transport the rack to the unloading area, I specifically informed the supervisor and a few fellow inmates,
items.translation: To ensure someone could transport the rack to the unloading area, I specifically informed the supervisor and a few fellow inmates,

items.translation: and struggled to crawl into the escape pod, tying all the tools to myself.

items.translation: I deliberately stuck a label on the outside of the mail package saying, 'FBI Important Evidence, Do Not Touch.'

items.text_zh: 做完这些，我已是尽其所能，后面的一切只能听天由命了。
items.draft: Having done all this, I had done everything I could; everything else was left to fate.
items.translation: Having done all this, I had done everything I could; everything else was left to fate.

items.text_zh: 我蜷缩在逃生舱当中，膝盖贴着额头，
items.draft: I curled up inside the escape pod, my knees against my forehead,
items.translation: I curled up inside the escape pod, my knees against my forehead,

items.draft: biting the small tube leading to the lower rack for breathing in the nearly sealed space.
items.translation: biting the small tube leading to the lower rack for breathing in the nearly sealed space.

items.text_zh: 我感觉每分每一秒都是煎熬。
items.draft: I felt every minute and second was torture.
items.translation: I felt every minute and second was torture.

items.text_zh: 八点三十五分，我突然感觉到整个托架被叉车叉起，然后运来运去。
items.draft: At eight thirty-five, I suddenly felt the entire rack being lifted by a forklift and moved around.
items.translation: At eight thirty-five, I suddenly felt the entire rack being lifted by a forklift and moved around.

items.text_zh: 那一刻，我几乎抑制不住内心的狂喜。要不是怕发出声音暴露，我真想大声欢呼。
items.draft: At that moment, I could hardly contain my inner joy. If I weren't afraid of making noise and exposing myself, I would have wanted to cheer loudly.
items.translation: At that moment, I could hardly contain my inner joy. If I weren't afraid of making noise and exposing myself, I would have wanted to cheer loudly.

items.text_zh: 但兴奋过后是痛苦。我转运到装卸平台后，整整半个小时，没有动静，
items.draft: But after the excitement came the pain. After being transferred to the unloading platform, there was no movement for a full half hour,
items.translation: But after the excitement came the pain. After being transferred to the unloading platform, there was no movement for a full half hour,

items.text_zh: 阳光暴晒，下舱内温度骤升，我感觉到无法呼气，每一次呼吸都是一场挣扎，
items.draft: the sun blazed down, the temperature inside the pod rose sharply, and I felt unable to exhale; each breath was a struggle,
items.translation: the sun blazed down, the temperature inside the pod rose sharply, and I felt unable to exhale; each breath was a struggle,

items.text_zh: 甚至随时会晕倒死在其中。
items.draft: and I felt like I could faint and die in there at any moment.
items.translation: and I felt like I could faint and die in there at any moment.

items.text_zh: 但直觉告诉我，这是黎明前的黑暗，我必须要坚持住。
items.draft: But my intuition told me this was the darkness before dawn, and I had to hold on.
items.translation: But my intuition told me this was the darkness before dawn, and I had to hold on.

items.text_zh: 终于在九点多托架被顺利转运走，穿过了一道道铁门。最终抵达监狱外的中转舱，
items.draft: Finally, around nine o'clock, the rack was successfully transported through several iron gates, reaching the transfer pod outside the prison.
items.translation: Finally, around nine o'clock, the rack was successfully transported through several iron gates, reaching the transfer pod outside the prison.

items.text_zh: 可惜舱惑工人一直在边上工作谈话，我不敢有任何行动，
items.draft: Unfortunately, the workers were still talking and working nearby, and I dared not make any moves,
items.translation: Unfortunately, the workers were still talking and working nearby, and I dared not make any moves,

items.text_zh: 直到十一点左右，工人们都去吃饭了。我知道这是个好机会。
items.draft: until around eleven o'clock when the workers went to lunch. I knew this was a good opportunity.
items.translation: until around eleven o'clock when the workers went to lunch. I knew this was a good opportunity.

items.text_zh: 考虑到监狱是下午四点钟例行点名，
items.draft: Considering that the prison conducts roll call at four in the afternoon,
items.translation: Considering that the prison conducts roll call at four in the afternoon,

items.text_zh: 所以我必须要抓紧时间用小刀割开束缚艰难的爬出逃生舱。
items.draft: I had to hurry and use the small knife to cut the bindings and crawl out of the escape pod.
items.translation: I had to hurry and use the small knife to cut the bindings and crawl out of the escape pod.

items.text_zh: 当适应了外面的光线之后，思绪飞快运转。肾上腺素激增的是如此强烈，
items.draft: Once I adapted to the light outside, my thoughts raced. The surge of adrenaline was so intense,
items.translation: Once I adapted to the light outside, my thoughts raced. The surge of adrenaline was so intense,

items.text_zh: 让我的嗅觉、听觉、行觉借入前所未有的敏锐状态。
items.draft: that my sense of smell, hearing, and touch became extraordinarily sharp.
items.translation: that my sense of smell, hearing, and touch became extraordinarily sharp.

items.text_zh: 借着树丛掩护，穿过了建筑群，却被一片正在施工的新区域截断了去路。
items.draft: Using the bushes for cover, I crossed the buildings, but my path was blocked by a new construction area.
items.translation: Using the bushes for cover, I crossed the buildings, but my path was blocked by a new construction area.

items.text_zh: 考虑到目标太明显，我在这里被困了一个小时，最终决定冒险向西行进，
items.draft: Considering the target was too obvious, I was trapped here for an hour and ultimately decided to risk moving west,
items.translation: Considering the target was too obvious, I was trapped here for an hour and ultimately decided to risk moving west,

items.text_zh: 穿过横贯监狱建筑群的狭窄柏油路，潜入一片林地。
items.draft: crossing the narrow asphalt road that runs through the prison complex and slipping into a wooded area.
items.translation: crossing the narrow asphalt road that runs through the prison complex and slipping into a wooded area.

items.text_zh: 为了迷惑警犬，我跪伏在地，以交错迂回的方式绕圈爬行，
items.draft: To confuse the police dogs, I knelt down and crawled in a zigzag pattern,
items.translation: To confuse the police dogs, I knelt down and crawled in a zigzag pattern,

items.draft: leaving a scent trail and soon discovered a small pond nearby.
items.translation: leaving a scent trail and soon discovered a small pond nearby.

items.text_zh: 为了进一步迷惑警犬，我又绕着小池塘绕了数圈，最后来到监狱南侧的空军基地路。
items.draft: To further confuse the police dogs, I circled the pond several times, finally reaching the Air Force base road on the south side of the prison.
items.translation: To further confuse the police dogs, I circled the pond several times, finally reaching the Air Force base road on the south side of the prison.

items.text_zh: 这里有一道一点五米高的铁丝围栏。
items.draft: There was a barbed wire fence about 1.5 meters high.
items.translation: There was a barbed wire fence about 1.5 meters high.

items.text_zh: 就在我翻阅之时，一名女子驾车刚好经过并看到了我。
items.draft: Just as I was climbing over, a woman drove by and saw me.
items.translation: Just as I was climbing over, a woman drove by and saw me.

items.text_zh: 我知道这是一个致命漏洞，但我无计可施，只能尽快逃离。

items.translation: I knew this was a fatal flaw, but I had no choice but to escape quickly.

items.text_zh: 沿着监狱外侧的铁路向南狂奔。

items.translation: I ran south along the railway outside the prison.

items.text_zh: 我之前研究过路线，想先逃亡到路易斯安那州的亚历山大市，

items.translation: I had previously studied the route and planned to escape to Alexandria, Louisiana,

items.translation: where there were many people and cars; I planned to switch vehicles there.

items.translation: According to my plan, since my movements would only be discovered at four in the morning,

items.translation: I would have already run far away, which would be unexpected for the authorities.

items.draft: And immediately issue a prison break alert.
items.translation: And immediately issue a prison break alert.

items.translation: The woman who witnessed me climbing over the fence also reported to the police after seeing the news.

items.text_zh: 所以，当我好不容易沿着铁轨跑到路易斯安那州鲍尔镇附近，
items.draft: So, when I finally ran along the tracks near Ball, Louisiana,
items.translation: So, when I finally ran along the tracks near Ball, Louisiana,

items.draft: the authorities had already begun a full search, with police patrolling near the tracks.
items.translation: the authorities had already begun a full search, with police patrolling near the tracks.

items.text_zh: 四点左右，我沿着铁轨奔跑时，突然前面出现了一名警察，
items.draft: Around four o'clock, as I was running along the tracks, a police officer suddenly appeared ahead,
items.translation: Around four o'clock, as I was running along the tracks, a police officer suddenly appeared ahead,

items.text_zh: 我知道那是抓我的，但对方可能已经看到了，我我不能跑，只能硬着头皮继续前进。
items.draft: I knew they were after me, but they might have already seen me, so I couldn't run and had to keep moving forward.
items.translation: I knew they were after me, but they might have already seen me, so I couldn't run and had to keep moving forward.

items.text_zh: 此时，我的大脑飞速运转，思考各种应变方式。
items.draft: At that moment, my brain was racing, considering various contingency plans.
items.translation: At that moment, my brain was racing, considering various contingency plans.

items.text_zh: 如果对方直接上来就扣我，那我只能反抗逃脱。
items.draft: If they came directly to arrest me, I would have to resist and escape.
items.translation: If they came directly to arrest me, I would have to resist and escape.

items.text_zh: 如果对方只是询问，那或许还有一线生机。
items.draft: If they were just asking questions, there might still be a glimmer of hope.
items.translation: If they were just asking questions, there might still be a glimmer of hope.

items.translation: Thus, Canada quickly extradited him to the U.S.

items.translation: Richard himself,

items.draft: was already facing two life sentences, and the additional years for three escape attempts didn't hold much significance.
items.translation: was already facing two life sentences, and the additional years for three escape attempts didn't hold much significance.

items.translation: On April 18, 2008, he was transferred to Florence Supermax Prison.

items.translation: It is among the most secure prisons in the country.

items.text_zh: 专门关押着一些最不可控、最危险的罪犯。至今从未有人成功从这里逃脱。
items.draft: It is specifically designed to hold the most uncontrollable and dangerous criminals. No one has ever successfully escaped from here.
items.translation: It is specifically designed to hold the most uncontrollable and dangerous criminals. No one has ever successfully escaped from here.

items.draft: Considering Richard's history of prison breaks,
items.translation: Considering Richard's history of prison breaks,

items.translation: the prison authorities took special care of him, placing him in an extremely high-end single cell.

items.translation: The window of this cell has only a ten-centimeter wide slit,

items.translation: so even on sunny days, only a few minutes of sunlight can come in each day.

items.translation: and the remaining twenty-three hours are strictly locked in solitary confinement,

items.translation: Perhaps Richard still has thoughts of escaping, but facing the hellish difficulty, he probably feels helpless.

items.translation: going from barely being able to function normally to experiencing auditory hallucinations and paranoia.

items.translation: In April 2008, crime reporter Byron attempted to communicate with Richard in prison. He didn't have high hopes,

items.translation: but to his surprise, Richard replied, and very enthusiastically.

items.text_zh: 他不仅毫无保留的讲述了自己三次越狱的全过程，

items.translation: He not only shared the entire process of his three escapes without reservation,

items.draft: but also laid out his psychological activities and planning details.
items.translation: but also laid out his psychological activities and planning details.

items.translation: After five years of correspondence,

items.translation: During these five years, Richard was kept in solitary confinement, unable to communicate with anyone,

items.translation: which might be why he was willing to correspond with Byron and share his story.

items.translation: After all, humans are social animals, and long-term lack of communication can be detrimental.

items.translation: The e-book The Man Who Swam Out of Prison sparked a huge response.

items.text_zh: 甚至在监狱内部都传开了，
items.draft: It even spread within the prison,
items.translation: It even spread within the prison,

items.text_zh: 不知道预防是出于压力还是理查德确实表现的规规矩矩。

items.translation: and it's unclear whether the preventive measures were due to pressure or if Richard was indeed behaving well.

items.draft: In September 2013, he was finally released from extreme isolation,
items.translation: In September 2013, he was finally released from extreme isolation,

items.translation: transferred to a regular cell where he could communicate normally with other inmates. He said that at that moment, he felt reborn.

items.translation: In 2020, the paperback version of this book was released again and became a bestseller, further increasing his fame outside prison.
